$comment: Neutral skill metadata. Install composes per-harness frontmatter from these fields; the SKILL.md bodies stay harness-agnostic.

skills.name: visual-diff
skills.description: Verify UI you just built by replaying it: capture the workflow, diff it against a previous iteration, summarize what changed, and hand over a live report. Use after changing any user-visible component, layout, style, route, or copy, and before claiming a UI change works.

skills.name: visual-diff-flows
skills.description: Author or edit a visual-diff flow spec: the closed step vocabulary, stable step ids, masking volatile content, viewport and network modes. Use when no flow covers the feature under work, or when a flow needs changing.

skills.name: visual-diff-review
skills.description: Interpret visual-diff findings and pull back human comments left on the report. Use when a diff exists and needs explaining, or when the user has annotated the report page.

commands.description: Capture the current UI, diff it against the previous iteration, and open the report.
Read pending report feedback and the latest findings, then act on them.
